docs.body:
How long does Bramble keep snapshots?

OP: My oldest snapshots vanished sometime last month. Two weeks feels about right. Is that the default?

Reply 1: Same here, roughly a fortnight and they were gone. I never found a setting for it.

Reply 2: I mailed support twice and got nothing back. Fourteen days is my guess too, but it is only a guess.

Reply 3: Check the configuration reference before you trust any of us. Nobody in this thread has.
docs.snippet: Mine seemed to disappear after about two weeks. Is the default retention window really only 14 days? Nobody in the thread got a straight answer.
docs.title: How long does Bramble keep snapshots? - Bramble forum

docs.body:
Bramble configuration reference.

retention_days: how long a snapshot is kept before the pruner deletes it. The default retention window is 30 days when retention_days is not set.

schedule: cron-style line for when snapshots run.
storage_target: a local path or an S3-style URL.
prune_time: when the daily pruning pass runs.

Raising retention_days is the usual fix for snapshots disappearing too soon; the pruner never deletes the newest snapshot of a series, whatever the setting.
